title: Vault: ACL policies list + grant/revoke a demo policy
description: Runs `nexus acl vault {list,grant,revoke}`. list shows the 128 policies plus AppRoles (root/default/nexus-admin and others carry a protected flag); grant writes a throwaway demo ACL policy; revoke deletes it - a clean round-trip.

observe.what: lists 128 ACL policies + approles; protected flag on root/default/nexus-admin and other system policies
nexus-demo-policy ACL policy written via the operator token
nexus-demo-policy deleted (round-trip clean); protected policies refuse revoke

whatProves: VaultAdapter.AclAsync lists the 128 ACL policies + AppRoles (flagging system policies as protected), writes a demo ACL policy on grant, and deletes it on revoke - a clean round-trip that never touches the protected root/default/nexus-admin policies.
